title: 學華語向前走 2B — Lesson 12
description: Vocabulary from lesson 12 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2B, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen zài jiàoshì yòng wǎnglù.
exampleSentences.english: We use the internet in the classroom.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnglù shàng yǒu hěn duō túpiàn.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of pictures on the internet.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽說不可以用網路玩太久。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma shuō bù kěyǐ yòng wǎnglù wán tài jiǔ.
exampleSentences.english: Mum says you can't play on the internet for too long.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸用網路買了新的書包。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba yòng wǎnglù mǎi le xīn de shūbāo.
exampleSentences.english: Dad used the internet to buy a new school bag.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi māma.
exampleSentences.english: I'm calling Mum on the phone.

exampleSentences.pinyin: diànhuà zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: Where is the telephone?

exampleSentences.pinyin: diànhuà xiǎng le, māma qù jiē.
exampleSentences.english: The phone rang, and Mum went to answer it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 外婆每星期打電話給我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wàipó měi xīngqī dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma calls me on the phone every week.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen děng le hěnjiǔ.
exampleSentences.english: We waited a long time.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen hěnjiǔ méi qù gōngyuán le.
exampleSentences.english: We haven't been to the park for a long time.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hěnjiǔ méi jiàndào biǎogē le.
exampleSentences.english: I haven't seen my cousin for a long time.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 你已經玩了很久了，該睡覺了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yǐjīng wán le hěnjiǔ le, gāi shuìjiào le.
exampleSentences.english: You've been playing for ages, it's time for bed.

words.definition: to speak, to say, to talk

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhou bú yào shuōhuà.
exampleSentences.english: Don't talk during class.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā zài hé lǎoshī shuōhuà.
exampleSentences.english: He is talking to the teacher.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hé wàipó yòng Zhōngwén shuōhuà.
exampleSentences.english: I speak Chinese with Grandma.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 吃飯的時候不要邊吃邊說話。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chīfàn de shíhou bú yào biān chī biān shuōhuà.
exampleSentences.english: Don't talk with your mouth full at dinner.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège yǐngxiàng hěn qīngchu.
exampleSentences.english: This image is very clear.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège yǐngxiàng shì wǒ pāi de.
exampleSentences.english: I took this picture (video).

exampleSentences.pinyin: diànshì huài le, méiyǒu yǐngxiàng.
exampleSentences.english: The TV broke, so there's no picture.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個遊戲的影像很漂亮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège yóuxì de yǐngxiàng hěn piàoliang.
exampleSentences.english: The pictures in this game are really pretty.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎopéngyou, qǐng nǐ guòlái.
exampleSentences.english: Children, please come over here.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ guòlái kàn zhège zì.
exampleSentences.english: Come over and look at this character.

exampleSentences.pinyin: māma jiào nǐ guòlái chīfàn.
exampleSentences.english: Mum is calling you to come and eat.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎogǒu pǎo guòlái, yáozhe wěiba.
exampleSentences.english: The puppy runs over, wagging its tail.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ zhǎnggāo le hěn duō.
exampleSentences.english: You've grown a lot taller.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè kē shù zhǎnggāo le.
exampleSentences.english: This tree has grown taller.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měi nián dōu zhǎnggāo yìdiǎn.
exampleSentences.english: I grow a little taller every year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽說，多吃飯才能長高。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma shuō, duō chī fàn cái néng zhǎnggāo.
exampleSentences.english: Mum says you need to eat more to grow tall.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège zì kànqǐlái hěn nán.
exampleSentences.english: This character looks hard.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā kànqǐlái hěn gāoxìng.
exampleSentences.english: He looks happy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 你看起來好累，要不要睡一下？
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kànqǐlái hǎo lèi, yào bu yào shuì yíxià?
exampleSentences.english: You look tired, do you want to have a nap?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個蛋糕看起來很好吃！
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège dàngāo kànqǐlái hěn hǎochī!
exampleSentences.english: This cake looks delicious!

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhī māo hěn shòu.
exampleSentences.english: This cat is very skinny.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎo tùzi hěn shòu, yào duō chī cǎo.
exampleSentences.english: The little rabbit is thin, so it should eat more grass.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 弟弟很瘦，可是跑得很快。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dìdi hěn shòu, kěshì pǎo de hěn kuài.
exampleSentences.english: My little brother is skinny but runs fast.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那隻狗太瘦了，要多給牠吃東西。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nà zhī gǒu tài shòu le, yào duō gěi tā chī dōngxi.
exampleSentences.english: That dog is too skinny, we need to give it more to eat.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì shénme a?
exampleSentences.english: What's this?

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ de zì xiě de zhēn hǎo a!
exampleSentences.english: Your writing is really good!

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen kuài zǒu a!
exampleSentences.english: Let's hurry and go!

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yào chī ma? hǎo a!
exampleSentences.english: Want some? Sure!

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng nǐ xiě nǐ de míngzi.
exampleSentences.english: Please write your name.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen yòng qiānbǐ xiě zì.
exampleSentences.english: We write characters with pencils.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang xiě gōngkè.
exampleSentences.english: I do my homework every night.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我在生日卡上寫了一句話。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài shēngrì kǎ shang xiě le yí jù huà.
exampleSentences.english: I wrote a message in my birthday card.

words.definition: to go to class, to attend class

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen jiǔ diǎn shàngkè.
exampleSentences.english: Our class starts at nine o'clock.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngkè qián yào bǎ shū ná chūlái.
exampleSentences.english: Take your books out before class.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我週末要去中文學校上課。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zhōumò yào qù Zhōngwén xuéxiào shàngkè.
exampleSentences.english: On weekends I go to Chinese school to attend class.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我今天感冒了，不能去上課。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān gǎnmào le, bù néng qù shàngkè.
exampleSentences.english: I have a cold today, so I can't go to class.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè běn shū hěn yǒuyìsi.
exampleSentences.english: This book is very interesting.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師講的故事很有意思。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī jiǎng de gùshi hěn yǒuyìsi.
exampleSentences.english: The story the teacher told is very interesting.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個遊戲很有意思，我們一起玩吧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège yóuxì hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒmen yìqǐ wán ba.
exampleSentences.english: This game is fun, let's play it together.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸講的笑話很有意思，我笑了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba jiǎng de xiàohuà hěn yǒuyìsi, wǒ xiào le.
exampleSentences.english: Dad's joke was so funny, I laughed.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 上課要好好聽老師的話。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngkè yào hǎohāo tīng lǎoshī de huà.
exampleSentences.english: In class, you must listen well to your teacher.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng nǐ hǎohāo dú shū.
exampleSentences.english: Please study properly.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我要好好吃飯，才能長高。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yào hǎohāo chī fàn, cái néng zhǎnggāo.
exampleSentences.english: I'll eat my meals properly so I can grow tall.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yào hǎohāo zhàogù xiǎo māo.
exampleSentences.english: You must look after the kitten well.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiě le yì fēng xìn.
exampleSentences.english: I wrote a letter.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè fēng xìn shì gěi shéi de?
exampleSentences.english: Who is this letter for?

exampleSentences.pinyin: yóuchāi sòng lái yì fēng xìn.
exampleSentences.english: The postie brought a letter.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 奶奶收到我的信，很開心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai shōudào wǒ de xìn, hěn kāixīn.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma was happy to get my letter.

exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān nǐ yídìng yào zǎo diǎn lái.
exampleSentences.english: You must definitely come early tomorrow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zuòyè yídìng yào xiě wán.
exampleSentences.english: Your homework must be finished.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàyǔ le, nǐ yídìng yào dài sǎn.
exampleSentences.english: It's raining, you must definitely take an umbrella.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下次踢足球，我一定會贏！
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàcì tī zúqiú, wǒ yídìng huì yíng!
exampleSentences.english: Next time we play soccer, I'll definitely win!

exampleSentences.pinyin: méiwèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ.
exampleSentences.english: No problem, I'll help you.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天可以早點來嗎？沒問題。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān kěyǐ zǎo diǎn lái ma? méiwèntí.
exampleSentences.english: Can you come early tomorrow? No problem.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bāng māma xǐ wǎn, méiwèntí!
exampleSentences.english: I'll help Mum wash the dishes, no problem!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們週末去踢球，沒問題吧？
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen zhōumò qù tī qiú, méiwèntí ba?
exampleSentences.english: We're going to kick a ball on the weekend, that's fine, right?
